# 1009. Complement of Base 10 Integer

## Solution 1 (time O(log(n)), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def bitwiseComplement(self, n):
        """
        :type n: int
        :rtype: int
        """
        if n == 0:
            return 1
        ans = 0
        cur_base = 1
        while n > 0:
            ans += (1 - (n % 2)) * cur_base
            n = n // 2
            cur_base *= 2
        return ans
```
